_README: THIS IS THE ONLY FILE THAT NEEDS EDITING TO CHANGE APPOINTMENT AVAILABILITY. Edit 'days' below. Dates in the past disappear from the website automatically — you never have to clean up stale slots. If 'days' is empty or every date has passed, the website stops showing a slot picker and shows an email fallback instead, so the site can never display a time that is not real.
_HOW_TO_EDIT: Each entry in 'days' needs a date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a list of times. Times use 24-hour format ('09:00', '14:30'). Set "status": "taken" to show a time as already booked (it appears greyed out and cannot be selected). Delete the line entirely to hide it completely.
_BOOKING_URL_NOTE: When the Google Calendar appointment schedule exists, paste its booking-page link into 'booking_url' below. The website will then send patients straight to Google Calendar for real self-scheduling, and the manual slot picker is bypassed automatically. Until then leave it as null.
